out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Not posted
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed cook touch bowl covered in raw chicken juice then touch garnish for final plating.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI food discarded and hands washed LE THAI CUISINE (Inspection Date: 06/12/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed 65f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: Food obtained from approved source

violations.corrective_action: Food prepared in a private home may NOT be used or offered for human consumption in a food establishment. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the bleach bucket with a concentration of 0ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CDI 50ppm

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed meat measuring cups located at the prep table. that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI wash rinsed sanitized

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: hard boiled eggs 8 days old
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: flat rice noodles placed back in refrigerator after 4 hour time control. Chinese broccoli and eggs not thrown away after 4 hours. Incorrect time label observed for rice kept on time control
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control : 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. CDI food discarded. Correct time written on rice

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Degreaser near wok station
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI labeled

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling rice in deep plastic container, cooling curry in deep metal container in melted water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI put in shallow trays to cool in WIC

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution

violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Green rice balls at 55f over 6 hours.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, ROP (2 or more barriers)
violations.observation: The person in charge described a method of packaging the following food using Reduced Oxygen Packaging requiring a variance from the Health Department: curry is cooked, cooled, vacuum sealed, then frozen. Bags are thawed in microwave/reheated per order.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1) smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2) curing food, 3) using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4) packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5) operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6) custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7) preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regulatory Authority to require a variance, or 8) sprouting seeds or beans. CDI curry bags will be date/time marked upon packing and then frozen. Bags will not be left out/in refrigerator for more than 48 hours.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: knives stored between equipment cracks that are unclean.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI stored in metal bucket

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw chicken wings stored over cut eggplant and uncooked tilapia inside of 2 dr preptop cooler on cook line. Observed uncooked shrimp stored above uncooked chopped vegetables inside of 1 dr preptop cooler on cook line. Observed raw shelled eggs stored above uncooked squid and cooked rice inside of walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS instructed CFM to relocate uncooked shrimp, chicken, and shelled eggs below RTE food and vegetables and food items with lower cook temps in all coolers.
